exposure: Mild and severe hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP)
Quartiles of leukocyte, monocyte, and neutrophil counts
cohort: 38,194 pregnant women recruited in the Japan Environment and Children's Study (JECS) from 15 Regional Centers across Japan between January 2011 and March 2014
finding: High leukocyte and monocyte counts in the first trimester are associated with the development of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP).
